name: showreel-14-stagger

voice.text: Why does your list feel so flat? Every item lands at once, so the whole thing hits like a wall. The fix: stagger. Same animation, each item 40 milliseconds after the last. Now the eye flows top to bottom. One variable, one delay, pure CSS.

caption:
Why does your list feel so flat? 🧱

When every row runs the same entrance at the same moment, the list lands as one block. Keep the animation and delay each row a little: animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 40ms), with --i set to the row's index. Now the eye reads it top to bottom. Works on lists, menus, feeds and card grids. Pure CSS, no library.
Save it for your next list, or send it to whoever builds your UI.
